annotation.authors_or_issuer: Timbalan Perdana Menteri Malaysia (Deputy Prime Minister's Office), Government of Malaysia
named_instruments_referenced: Malaysia National AI Governance and Ethics Guidelines (AIGE)
annotation.summary_en: Speech by Malaysia's Deputy Prime Minister at the launch of the National AI Governance and Ethics Guidelines (AIGE), 20 Sept 2024. It stresses AI's economic benefits, adoption, AI literacy, and how AIGE complements the Cyber Security Act, PDPA, the forthcoming data-sharing bill and the National AI Office, aligned with ASEAN efforts.
key_provisions_or_claims: AIGE guidelines launched to strengthen digital ecosystem trust and complement existing laws
National AI Office (NAIO) to begin operating November 2024 under MyDIGITAL Corporation
Data Sharing Bill draft and proposed Malaysia Data Commission announced
AIGE aligned with ASEAN AI governance and ethics guidance; Malaysia ASEAN Chair 2025
AI literacy programme 'AI Untuk Rakyat' reached over one million people
annotation.title_clean: Peluncuran Garis Panduan Tadbir Urus dan Etika Kecerdasan Buatan Negara
annotation.title_en: Launch of the National Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Governance and Ethics
